text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Robert Mugabe on Monday named an 11-member commission of inquiry to investigate the manner in which claims for compensation under the War Victims Compensation Act were submitted, assessed and granted between November 1980 and April 1997.
- Some 900 delegates have so far arrived for the fourth African/African-American summit which begins in Harare on Tuesday.
- A lawyer is standing trial at the Harare Magistrates Court for allegedly misappropriating more than Z$100,000 belonging to a client which was supposed to be held in a trust account.
